post_evidence_operational.failed: The first post-evidence push-and-ancestry wrapper placed a Git command and an exit-code comparison inside one parenthesized PowerShell expression, so the wrapper failed at parse time and no command in it ran.
post_evidence_operational.recovery: Run each ancestry command as its own statement and capture LASTEXITCODE only after the command returns.
post_evidence_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not embed semicolon-separated native commands inside a parenthesized PowerShell value expression.

post_evidence_operational.failed: The first closeout-template inventory piped a bare foreach statement directly into ConvertTo-Json, so PowerShell rejected the empty pipeline element before reading any file.
post_evidence_operational.recovery: Materialize the foreach results in an explicit array and pipe that array to ConvertTo-Json.
post_evidence_operational.recurrence_guard: Wrap statement-producing foreach blocks in an array expression before applying a PowerShell pipeline.
